name: Salmon Teriyaki Don
notes: Estimate. Grilled salmon in teriyaki on about 250g of Japanese rice, with salad. Sides ordered with it are separate rows here.

name: Salmon Shioyaki Don
notes: Estimate. Salt-grilled rather than glazed, so about 50 kcal under the teriyaki version and 11g less sugar.

name: Salmon Belly Don
notes: Estimate. Belly is the fatty cut: less protein and nearly twice the fat of the fillet, for a similar plate.

name: Yakiniku Salmon Don
notes: Estimate. Salmon with shimeji and onions in yakiniku sauce, and the onsen egg comes in the bowl.

name: Yakiniku Beef Don
notes: Estimate. Their number one seller. Sliced beef, shimeji, onions and an onsen egg on rice.

name: Chicken Teriyaki Don
notes: Estimate. The leanest of the dons here, and the cheapest.

name: Chicken Mushroom Teriyaki Don
notes: Estimate. Chicken thigh with shimeji and onions. No salad on this one, so slightly less fibre.

name: Chicken Karaage Don
notes: Estimate. Fried, then finished with mayo — the mayo alone is about 100 kcal of it.

name: Chicken Katsu Curry Don
notes: Estimate. The biggest bowl on the menu: breaded cutlet plus a curry sauce that carries its own fat.

name: Salmon Teriyaki Salad Bowl
notes: Estimate. No rice, so half the carbs of the don and three times the fibre. Most of the fat is the sesame dressing.

name: Saba Teriyaki Salad Bowl
notes: Estimate. Mackerel, so it counts as an oily fish for the omega-3 badge.

name: Chicken Karaage Salad Bowl
notes: Estimate. Salad base with fried chicken on it — the salad saves the rice, the frying spends it again.

name: Chicken Teriyaki Bento
notes: Estimate. The whole set as served: chicken, rice, gyoza, edamame, salad and miso soup.

name: Chicken Karaage Garlic Fried Rice Bento
notes: Estimate. The largest single item here. Garlic fried rice carries roughly 100 kcal more than steamed.

name: Salmon Lover Platter (9 pcs)
notes: Estimate. 4 salmon nigiri and 5 salmon sashimi. The best protein-to-calorie ratio on this menu.

name: Kids Lover Platter (29 pcs)
notes: Estimate. 7 inari, 15 kappa maki, 7 tamago nigiri. Mostly rice — meant to be shared, not eaten alone.

name: Premium Salmon Platter (35 pcs)
notes: Estimate. A sharing platter: maki, makimono, aburi, mentai nigiri, nigiri and sashimi. Log a fraction of it unless you really did eat all 35.

name: Miso Soup
notes: Estimate. Cheap in calories, heavy in salt.

name: Onsen Egg
notes: Estimate. Already counted inside the yakiniku dons — only add this if you ordered a second one.

name: Fried Gyoza (2 pcs)
notes: Estimate. Already inside both bentos; this row is for ordering them on the side.

name: Chicken Karaage (2 pcs)
notes: Estimate. The side portion, not the don.

name: Takoyaki (6 pcs)
notes: Estimate. Batter, mayo and sauce do most of this; the octopus is a small part of it.

name: Edamame
notes: Estimate. The best side here by a distance: 11g of protein and 5g of fibre for 125 kcal.

name: Soya Tofu Pudding
notes: Estimate. The free one they give for a five-star rating. Free of charge is not free of calories.

name: Ayataka Green Tea
notes: Estimate. Unsweetened, so effectively nothing. The drink to pick if the meal is already big.

name: Coke
notes: Estimate. 35g of sugar, which is most of a day's added sugar in one can.
